items.headline: Top DE D.J. Jacobs commits to Miami hours after pulling Ohio State commitment
items.description: Five-star defensive end D.J. Jacobs, the No. 2 overall recruit in the 2027 class, committed to Miami on Thursday hours after pulling his commitment from Ohio State.

items.headline: Sources: Michigan QB Bryce Underwood expected to start vs. rival Ohio State
items.description: Michigan QB Bryce Underwood, who had been dealing with a hamstring injury, is now expected to start Saturday against Ohio State, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel.

items.headline: D.J. Jacobs decommits from Ohio State, sources say, making top DE available again
items.description: D.J. Jacobs, the No. 2 overall recruit in the 2027 class, has decommitted from Ohio State, sources told ESPN, with Tennessee, Georgia and Miami among the leading contenders for the five-star defensive end.

items.headline: Take a 360-degree look at college football's iconic rivalry trophies
items.description: Whether ancient, animal or absurd, college football's rivalry trophies take many shapes.

items.headline: In a rivalry built on titles, Michigan-Ohio State turns into a battle for only bragging rights
items.description: There is the tired cliché about throwing the records out when Michigan meets Ohio State and how a win in “The Game” can turn around perceptions about a disappointing season.

items.headline: Week 13 Game Day Kickoff: Nothing compares to the outright hatred of a rival
items.description: What to expect in Rivalry Week, from top games and players to teams on upset alert.
